2018 Financial Guidance Full year 2018 revenue and earnings guidance • PayPal expects revenue to grow 16 - 18% at current spot rates and 15 - 16% on an FX-neutral basis, to a range of $15.20 - $15.40 billion.
• PayPal expects GAAP earnings per diluted share in the range of $1.73 - $1.76 and non-GAAP earnings per diluted share in the range of $2.31 - $2.34.
Second quarter 2018 revenue and earnings guidance • PayPal expects revenue to grow 21% - 22% at current spot rates and 19% - 20% on an FX-neutral basis, to a range of $3.78 - $3.83 billion.
• PayPal expects GAAP earnings per diluted share in the range of $0.41 - $0.43 and non-GAAP earnings per diluted share in the range of $0.54 - $0.56.
